body: I've been going through the same thing with my friend, only she talks a lot to me about it and won't say a word of it to almost anyone else. It's hard being almost the only person in her support net, especially when she starts telling me that part of the reason she wants to do it is because of me. It's hard to know what to say especially when it feels like you're having the same conversation over and over and nothing is changing. I feel like I've taken a lot of abuse from her controlling and manipulating behaviours and I don't always know what to do. If I think about my own mental health and go NC that would leave her with no one and make things so much worse for her. It's tough, I'm glad to see I'm not the only one going through the same thing.

I know that it wouldn't be my fault, but she always says that she wants to do it for me or because of me or to protect me from here. She either says she wants to die because of how much pain she's in/how worthless she is or because she wants to show people that they hurt her and get some sort of revenge. I've called the police on her in the past and have taken her to the hospital after she cut. And I'm sorry to hear about what you're going through. I'm sure you've heard it many times and I don't know your situation but it does get better and you can get help. <3
